chansons.style: anthemic rock, distorted guitars, pounding live drums, raspy male vocal, festival crowd energy, 138 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Une nuit électrique sous les projecteurs d'un festival où la foule ne fait plus qu'un seul cœur battant.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(distorted guitar riff, crowd roar)
Yeah! Let the night ignite!

[Verse 1]
Ten thousand strangers in the dust and the flame
We traded our names for a louder refrain
The bassline is thunder, the snare is a spark
We're carving our story deep into the dark

[Pre-Chorus]
No sleep, no map, no turning around
We're chasing the sound that shakes up the ground

[Chorus]
Neon fields forever, we're burning so bright
Hands in the heavens, we own the whole night
Scream it out louder, let the speakers ignite
Neon fields forever, we're alive, we're alive!

[Verse 2]
Sweat on our faces, dust on our shoes
We've got nothing left to lose, nothing to prove
The singer is shouting, the crowd sings it back
A million wild hearts on a one-way track

[Pre-Chorus]
No sleep, no map, no turning around
We're chasing the sound that shakes up the ground

[Chorus]
Neon fields forever, we're burning so bright
Hands in the heavens, we own the whole night
Scream it out louder, let the speakers ignite
Neon fields forever, we're alive, we're alive!

[Bridge]
When the morning arrives and the magic is gone
We'll carry the echo and carry it on
One night, one song, one endless roar
This is the moment we've been waiting for

[Chorus]
Neon fields forever, we're burning so bright
Hands in the heavens, we own the whole night
Scream it out louder, let the speakers ignite
Neon fields forever, we're alive, we're alive!

[Outro]
Alive, alive, alive, alive!
(fading crowd chant, final power chord)

[Chorus]

[Verse 2]
Les miroirs d'hier ne me ressemblent plus
J'ai lavé mon nom sous un ciel inconnu

[Pre-Chorus]
Plus rien derrière, tout est devant
Je reprends la route comme un enfant

[Chorus]
Cendres et demain, je recommence
Je brise les chaînes, je force la chance
Cendres et demain, je prends le large
Un nouveau souffle, une nouvelle page
Oh-oh-oh, cendres et demain!

Je suis le cri, je suis l'écho

[Chorus]
Cendres et demain, je recommence
Je brise les chaînes, je force la chance
Cendres et demain, je prends le large
Un nouveau souffle, une nouvelle page
Oh-oh-oh, cendres et demain!

[Outro]
Demain, demain, demain...
(final sustained chord)

chansons.style: heartland rock, warm distorted guitars, steady live drums, gravelly male vocal, nostalgic vibe, 118 BPM

chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(jangly guitar, slow drum fill)
Mm-hmm...

[Verse 1]
Main Street is quieter than I recall
The diner still open, but barely at all
The factory whistle don't blow anymore
Just ghosts in the windows and dust on the floor

[Pre-Chorus]
But every crack in the pavement I know
Every kid on a bike with nowhere to go

[Chorus]
Oh, rust belt lullaby, sing me to sleep
These are the promises I still keep
Small town, big heart, heavy and true
Rust belt lullaby, I'm coming home to you

[Verse 2]
Friday night lights on a field gone brown
The same old bleachers still face the same town
My old man's truck is parked in the drive
Still running somehow, still barely alive

[Pre-Chorus]
And every crack in the pavement I know
Every kid on a bike with nowhere to go

[Chorus]
Oh, rust belt lullaby, sing me to sleep
These are the promises I still keep
Small town, big heart, heavy and true
Rust belt lullaby, I'm coming home to you

[Bridge]
They say you can't go back, but they never tried
Walking these sidewalks with tears in their eyes
This broken old city still beats in my chest
The place where my stubborn old soul found its rest

[Chorus]
Oh, rust belt lullaby, sing me to sleep
These are the promises I still keep
Small town, big heart, heavy and true
Rust belt lullaby, I'm coming home to you

[Outro]
Coming home, coming home...
(fading harmonica)

chansons.titre_fr: Lettres que je n'ai jamais envoyées
chansons.style: slow burn rock, moody distorted guitars, slow live drums, aching male vocal, homesick atmosphere, 112 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un exilé écrit sans cesse à sa terre perdue, accumulant des lettres qui ne partiront jamais.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(somber guitar line, soft cymbal swell)
Oh...

[Verse 1]
Another winter in a city of steel
Where nobody knows how my loneliness feels
I write to my mother in careful blue ink
But I fold up the page and I stand at the sink

[Pre-Chorus]
Three thousand miles of ocean and wire
Between my cold hands and my father's fire

[Chorus]
Letters I never sent, stacked on my shelf
Talking to no one, losing myself
Letters I never sent, stained with the rain
Calling out homeward, calling in vain

[Verse 2]
I dream of the harbor, the salt on my skin
The bell of the chapel where I learned to sin
The smell of the market, the bread, and the wine
The language I'm slowly forgetting in time

[Pre-Chorus]
Three thousand miles of ocean and wire
Between my cold hands and my father's fire

[Chorus]
Letters I never sent, stacked on my shelf
Talking to no one, losing myself
Letters I never sent, stained with the rain
Calling out homeward, calling in vain

[Bridge]
Maybe one day I'll board that old train
Maybe one day I'll whisper your name
But tonight I just write, and I fold, and I wait
A stranger in someone else's cruel state

[Chorus]
Letters I never sent, stacked on my shelf
Talking to no one, losing myself
Letters I never sent, stained with the rain
Calling out homeward, calling in vain

[Outro]
Calling in vain... calling in vain...
(fading single note)

Assez de chaînes, assez de lois

[Chorus]
